h1: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bhilai

h1Text: Outdoor Gym Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Bhilai

richText.heading: Outdoor gym equipment supplier in Bhilai

c: Bhilai is the steel city of Chhattisgarh, and much of it is laid out in planned sectors around the steel plant, each with its own parks, schools and community spaces. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor gym equipment in Bhilai to township and civic departments, schools, colleges, housing societies and private colonies in Durg district. We make the Fun Fitness range at our factory in Vasai, about 910 km away, and bring it by road.

A township with many sector parks usually wants one standard set that it can repeat park by park, often over more than one budget year. We can draw a single layout for a typical sector park, quote it once, and then supply it in phases. Each machine has its own base, so adding stations later does not disturb the ones already in the ground. Summers here are very hot and the monsoon is steady, so frames are galvanised and seats are roto-moulded plastic.

items.q: Can we order outdoor gym equipment for several parks in phases?
items.a: Yes. We prepare one layout and quote for a standard park, then supply it park by park as your budget allows. Each machine stands on its own footing, so later phases fit around earlier ones.

items.q: How much space does a 6 Station Multi Gym need?
items.a: It needs the frame area plus clear space on every side for users to sit, stand and step off. Send us your park plan and we will mark the exact zone on the drawing.

items.q: Do you supply Durg as well as Bhilai?
items.a: Yes. We deliver by road from Vasai to sites across Durg district and install with our own team or a dealer working in central India.
